mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_id, product_id, sku_id, quantity, product_name, product_price) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{productName}, #{productPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT id, cart_id, product_id, sku_id, product_name, product_price, quantity FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY id
